# FAMs Mobile Catering
FAMs is a family-run mobile catering company created by Florin, Alexandra, Mirela and Sofia.
Primary service area: Surrey, United Kingdom.
Additional service area: surrounding areas and further afield by arrangement.
Services: weddings, private parties, corporate events, birthdays, anniversaries and special occasions.
Brand promise: Good food. Great people. Lasting memories.
Tagline: Family food. Beautifully served. Memories made.
Key pages: /fams-website/about/ /fams-website/weddings/ /fams-website/private-parties/ /fams-website/corporate-events/ /fams-website/special-occasions/ /fams-website/faq/ /fams-website/contact/
